lessons.keep: Place the proposed mechanism beside the familiar system it imitates.
lessons.avoid: Avoid presenting an anatomical analogy as proof of clinical effectiveness.
lessons.open: Hearing benefit, suitability, fitting precision, price comparison, production cost, research basis, source rights and all audio delivery remain unverified.
try: Show a Tin brand profile beside the creative choices it controls, with matching labels.
Follow one input profile through generation, fabrication or publishing and a defined result instead of ending on process footage.
